author: U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA)
locator: Overview, Table 1, 'Strait of Hormuz' section & Table 3, 'Bab el-Mandeb' Table 4, and 'Cape of Good Hope' Table 8 (2024–2026 series)
notes: Establishes Strait of Hormuz flow at ~20.9 mb/d petroleum liquids (14.7 mb/d crude/condensate + 6.1 mb/d products, ~20% of global consumption) and 11.4 Bcf/d LNG (~20% of global LNG trade), with 89% of crude going to Asia. Quantifies unused overland bypass capacity on Saudi East-West Petroline and UAE ADCOP at ~4.7 mb/d.
